prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom Pet Realtime Preview Grid: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a visual grid layout with interactive preview components. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 67.9% and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation looking wrong or failing.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction Shortcut Cheat Sheet: Inserts a desktop control guide screen right before home intro showing hotkeys to hide, drag, and talk to the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or speak with the desktop pet.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Story Mode Path Selector: Replaces static introduction on story screen with a split layout pairing interactive mascot preview with companion choices. (why: Mean time spent on path selection is high (514s); interactive storytelling helps users decide faster.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Data Reset Prevention Warning Hint: Adds an account reset warning hint and protection badge on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in with different accounts.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Clarity Diagnostic Guidance: Adds specific photo formatting and resolution guidance hints on the upload photos screen. (why: 3 support issues cited custom pet generation errors or distorted pet appearances.)
5: [home, incentive] Desktop Spawning Audio Chime Incentive: Enables sound notifications and audio chime on the waiting screen when pet generation finishes. (why: Median waiting step takes 201s with long mean wait times (2336s); sound notifications bring distracted users back.)
6: [finish, incentive] Pet Arrival Starter Treat Welcome Prompt: Adds a welcome treat button and happy mascot asset on home intro to prompt instant interaction. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with long completion times (395s median, 5815s mean).)
7: [choose_path, wait_info] Onboarding Stage Step Counter Display: Displays progress bar and step counter on choose_path screen to set clear length expectations. (why: Path selection stage mean time is 514s; visible progress indicators decrease perceived effort.)
